questions.prompt: Which Container Apps change creates a new revision?

options.text: Changing the container image in the app template
Changing only an existing secret value
options.explanation: Secret values are application-scoped; revisions may need restarting to consume changes.
Changing the identity does not itself create a new revision.

questions.prompt: You want two Container Apps image versions active simultaneously, with 10% of ingress traffic sent to the new version. Which revision mode supports this?

options.explanation: It supports concurrent active revisions and traffic splitting.

options.text: Single revision mode as the steady deployment state
options.explanation: Single mode does not keep multiple active application versions for this canary design.

options.text: An ACI restart policy of Always
options.explanation: ACI restart policies are a different service mechanism.
That prevents the required incoming traffic split.

questions.prompt: A Container App image pulls successfully, but HTTP ingress cannot reach the process. The process listens on 8080 while ingress targets 80. What should be corrected?

options.text: Set the ingress target port to the actual listening port.
options.explanation: Ingress must forward to the port served by the container.

options.text: Grant the image publisher a broader push role only.
options.explanation: The image has already been pulled; publishing rights do not fix runtime routing.

options.text: Change only the revision label to 8080.
options.explanation: Labels do not set container listening or target ports.

options.text: Increase maximum replicas without changing the port.
options.explanation: More replicas with the same port mismatch remain unreachable.
